title: Relationships
subtitle: A calm, private place for the people and groups you choose.
entryBody: Your relationships keep the same identity even if you later open them from a different part of VexLife.
entryPreview: Preview opening from Home; your relationships stay the same.
emptyBody: You decide when to connect with someone.
virtual: This large list is shown in pages to keep it easy to browse.
summary: {class} · this is your label; their side stays separate.
connectBody: Choose how you want to share a connection invitation. This preview does not send or save anything yet.
held: Not ready yet. Check the invitation, identity, and your decision.
formed: A local relationship preview is ready. Nothing has been sent or saved.
alphaConsentBody: Joining the alpha is a separate choice from accepting this invitation or choosing your relationship label.
runtimeBody: Prepare a no-effect host-binding plan from the current verified relationship and connection gates. This does not connect, send, or save a relationship.
runtimeBoundary: No host plan has been prepared. Network execution stays separate.
runtimeHeld: Host plan held. Complete the required consent, invitation, identity, route, and recovery gates.
runtimeHostBindingRequired: Product gates are ready. A separate exact Mac + Windows host-binding step is required; no network connection has started.
runtimeFailure: The local host-plan request failed safely. Nothing was connected or saved.
deliveryBody: Sent, connected, delivered, and understood are different. Delivery never means understanding or friendship.
deliveryHeld: Connection activity stays paused until the invitation, identity, decision, and local reference are ready.
vexBody: Vex may explain or open the same Relationships place. Vex cannot decide, save, or revoke a relationship for you.
vexShow: Ask Vex to explain this step
vexExplanation: Verify the other person, choose your own scope, and remember that delivery never proves understanding or friendship.
recoveryBody: Block, revoke, withdraw, disconnect, and reset affect future actions; they do not rewrite history.
blocked: Blocked. New actions are held; prior history remains.
revoked: Revoked. Later invitation or session use is rejected; prior history remains.
withdrawn: Withdrawn. New participation is held; prior history remains.
disconnected: Disconnected. Connection activity is paused; the local relationship reference remains.
bookletBody: The list and visible people reuse the same relationship identities.
option.identity.stale: Identity information is out of date
